item.title: The Real Housewives Star Behind A Nationwide Fraud Scheme
item.description: Jennifer Shah built her reality-TV persona around wealth and luxury while prosecutors said she helped run a nationwide telemarketing fraud scheme that targeted hundreds of vulnerable victims, many of them elderly. Shah pleaded guilty to conspiracy to commit wire fraud and was sentenced in 2023 to 78 months in federal prison

item.title: The Father Who Shot His Son’s Abuser On Live TV
item.description: In 1984, Gary Plauché's 11-year-old son Jody was abducted and sexually abused by his karate instructor, Jeff Doucet. When Doucet was returned to Louisiana to face charges, Gary was waiting at the airport and shot him as television cameras recorded the moment. Plauché later pleaded no contest to manslaughter and received probation instead of prison time.
